summary: Caesarstone Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K attaching its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release and updated investor presentation. Results showed revenue of $96.3 million, gross margin of 25.4%, a net loss of $56.1 million (including $46.8 million tied to a California jury verdict), and near-breakeven adjusted EBITDA. The filing is a routine quarterly results disclosure, not a special situation; management noted disagreement with the verdict and intent to pursue post-trial remedies. Watch litigation contingencies, US demand softness, and restructuring cost savings rather than any deal catalyst.
